entities.summary: Blas de Otero was a Spanish poet, associated with the Social poetry movement of the 1950s and 60s in Spain. Blas de Otero was a poets & playwrights from Bilbao (1916-03-15, Bilbao–1979-06-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
